title: Demo Paper: Author Notification Email Verification

highwire_tags.citation_title: Demo Paper: Author Notification Email Verification
highwire_tags.citation_journal_title: Global Research Journal of Accounting and Finance
highwire_tags.citation_abstract:
Research Objective: This study serves as a demonstration submission to verify the post-publication author notification email of the AMSSRN auto-publication system.

Methodology: The study exercises the full pipeline, including metadata extraction, slot reservation, PDF galley conversion, R2 upload, frontend deployment, and scheduled author email.

Findings: The process confirms the operational verification of the author-facing notification email, including the landing-page link, volume and issue details, page range, and support contacts rendered from the employees table.

Conclusion: Upon receipt of the author email at the Tech Support address, this demonstration has served its purpose.
